metadata.title: Unripe Tomatoes with Fermented Fish | Home Recipe
metadata.description:
This is a very simple home recipe made of unripe tomatoes and fermented or dry fish. Unripe tomatoes are cooked with chillies and fermented fish to form a light gravy and it goes down really well with rice. 

Ingredients Required
Unripe tomatoes – as required
Chilies – 4-5 or mo
Dried or Fermented fresh water fish – 4-5 or more
Salt to taste
Water as required

Chop the tomatoes and slit the green chillies, wash the dried or fermented fish.

In a pan put the cut tomatoes, chillies and fermented fish, add required amount of salt and pour water.

Kalchi (lye) is optional, else you can use cooking soda too, which is also completely optional

Allow the whole thing to cook on medium flame for about 15 minutes. 

Once the tomatoes are well done, your dish is ready.

Serve with a plate of hot rice.

Thank you for watching, hope you make this dish at home and enjoy a hearty meal. ....
